businesses.business: life sciences sample management and genomics services

offering_description.value: Provides sample management solutions and multiomics services to life sciences, pharma, biotech, academic and healthcare customers. Offers cold-chain storage, biorepository and logistics services, sample storage automation and consumables, plus genomic sequencing and synthesis services delivered from labs and facilities.

primary_products.value: automated sample storage systems; cryogenic and cold-chain consumables; sample tubes and labware; laboratory informatics software

primary_services.value: biological sample storage and biorepository; sample logistics and transport; genomic sequencing services; gene synthesis; sample processing and analysis

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical and biotech companies, clinical labs, contract research organizations, hospitals; B2B: academic and private research institutions; B2G: government research institutes

end_markets.value: pharmaceuticals; biotechnology; academic research; clinical diagnostics; cell and gene therapy

revenue_model.value: service fees: sample storage, logistics, sequencing and gene synthesis services; product sales: automated storage systems, consumables and labware; subscription: software and recurring storage agreements

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in customer samples and delivers storage, logistics and genomic testing for life science customers; OEM / manufacturer: builds automated storage systems and consumables sold to labs and biobanks; asset operator: runs cold-chain storage facilities and genomics laboratories
value_chain_position.category: service provider; OEM / manufacturer; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific, including China, with facilities in the US, UK, Germany and elsewhere

specialization.value: related lines: sample management solutions and multiomics services for life science customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams to pharma, biotech, academic and clinical customers; online: web ordering for genomic services and consumables; distributors / dealers: regional distributors for consumables and instruments

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Handling of biological samples and patient data: GMP/GLP and quality standards, CLIA/CAP, HIPAA and GDPR, transport rules

notes: Portfolio has changed recently (e.g. divestitures), so product details may be slightly outdated.
